label: Bible Study
prompt: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little _____ to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
verse: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
note: 'Suffer' is KJV for 'allow' — Jesus was pro-children, not pro-suffering.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Fear not, little _____; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
verse: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
note: 'Little flock' — Jesus's tenderest nickname for the church, right before handing it a kingdom.

label: Sunday School
prompt: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery _____, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.
verse: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.
note: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego's confidence: 'burning fiery furnace' — the KJV doubles down on the heat.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye _____ bones, hear the word of the LORD.
verse: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.
note: Ezekiel preaches to a valley of skeletons — the least promising congregation in Scripture, and it revived.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he _____ together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
verse: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
note: 'Quickened' means made alive — the KJV's resurrection verb hiding in plain sight.
